basic_info.description: Welcome to your fully detached home on a 29-foot wide lot, featuring a 2-year-new roof! This bright and airy home sits on a quiet block near Rousseaus' Boulevard and shines as a one-of-a-kind gem that combines timeless charm with everyday comfort. The generously sized living room, formal dining room, and center patio fill the home with natural light and character. Two spacious bedrooms and a cheerful breakfast nook offer everyday ease, the bonus room downstairs provides extra space for a home office, gym, or playroom. A large backyard delivers both privacy and endless possibilities for outdoor enjoyment. Ideally located just a short stroll from playgrounds, parks, popular schools, and the vibrant cafes and restaurants along Irving and Noriega Streets. Easy access to Sunset Boulevard and Ocean Beach. This home offers the perfect mix of lifestyle and convenience. Make this beautiful home yours and step into a whole new world of possibilities!
